[C5]They speak a language of lies

[C5]Their mighty castles will burn

[Pre-Chorus]
[G5]A lesson to be learned
[D5]That the a-
[A5]maranth never fades

[Chorus]

[G5]It shall grow our graves

[C5]What she already knows
[A5]

[C5]There will be nothing to fear

[Pre-Chorus]
[G5]She will shed no tears
[D5]Because a-
[A5]maranth never fades

[Chorus]
[C5]As we live out our days
[G5]It will grow on our graves
[D5]When our bones
[A5]have all turned to dust

[Bridge]
[A5]
[C5]

[C5]

title: Turned To Dust
